title: Greywater Bay Rising Anew
author: Isandro Dunmore
blurb: Sebastian Sandoval, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
